subject: Acceptance & owner matrix — MSADPA gating items
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acceptance & owner matrix — MSADPA gating items

Team —

Following this morning's sync with Novacare (Emily + procurement), they asked for a tight owners matrix that maps the remaining acceptance gates to the contract documents (MSA / DPA / Order Form) and the evidence they need to sign off. I sketched a first pass and attached it. Key goals:

- Remove ambiguity on who owns each gate (Redwood vs Novacare).
- Identify which gates are contract dependencies (i.e., must be agreed in MSA/DPA) vs implementation checklist items in onboarding.
- Call out anything that blocks signature (e.g., data residency clause in DPA, SOC2 evidence).

Please review the attached Acceptance_Ownership_Matrix.xlsx and add owners in column C by end of day tomorrow. Vanessa — can you validate the SOC2 / security evidence rows with Security? Karthik — please flag any redlines required in the MSA that should be raised now. Laura — I'll need a short note I can send to their procurement explaining the proposed acceptance cutoff.

I want to propose the following timeline for closing:
- 6/22: Internal owners confirmed
- 6/23: Draft redlines & evidence package compiled
- 6/24: Joint review call with Novacare (target)
- 6/26: Signature target if no new blockers

Attachments: Acceptance_Ownership_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-21T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance & owner matrix — MSADPA gating items

+1 — I filled in a first pass for security-owned items in the sheet and left comments where I need further clarification from Novacare. Main notes:

- SOC 2 report: we can provide a redacted copy; Security wants to know if Novacare needs the full report or a summary.
- DPA: the data residency clause (Section 4) is likely to require a short amendment for their EU tenants; need legal sign-off.
- Access logs & retention: we can provide 90-day logs immediately and discuss extended retention as a separate SOW.

Two asks for the timeline: can we push the joint review to 6/24 afternoon so security has time to vet the compiled evidence? Also, Prioym, add me on the call invite to Novacare so I can present the evidence list.

-Vanessa
Director, Customer Security Operations

Hi Priyom / Vanessa —

Thanks for the matrix and quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

- For signature: Novacare requires that any acceptance criteria tied to PHI handling be reflected in the DPA. Can you confirm which acceptance rows we should expect to see reflected there vs an onboarding checklist?
- SOC2: we need either the full report under an NDA or a certified letter summarizing scope & effective dates. Procurement prefers the certified letter route to accelerate review.
- Order Form: pricing tiers and pilot term need to be final at signing. Can your AE confirm the pilot pricing is locked?

We can do 6/24 at 2pm PT for the joint review call. If you can send the assembled evidence package and a one-page acceptance snapshot beforehand that would be great.

Emily Chen
Sr. Manager, Procurement — Novacare Medical
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novacare.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novacare.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-24T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Acceptance accountability & next steps (materials attached)

Emily / team —

Thanks for confirming the 6/24 2pm PT slot — invite sent. Per the matrix and our internal review, here's the plan and attached materials:

1) What will be in the DPA at signature:
- PHI handling clauses (Section 4): language to be included documenting processing locations and subprocessors.
- Data deletion/return obligations post-termination (standard clause we will include).

2) What remains in onboarding (post-signature but required for go-live):
- Extended retention configuration (SOW to follow)
- Backfill of historical logs >90 days (separate project)

3) Evidence package attached:
- Acceptance_Ownership_Matrix.xlsx (owners column finalized)
- MSA-DPA-dependency-notes.pdf (summary of proposed MSA redlines and DPA items)

Quick answers to your questions: pilot pricing is locked for the 90-day pilot term listed on the order form; AE has confirmed no further discounting in this motion. For SOC2, Vanessa will provide a certified summary letter under NDA before the 6/24 call.

Requested next steps:
- 6/24 14:00 PT: joint review call (invite)
- 6/25 EOD: procurement to confirm whether DPA language is acceptable or requires redline
- 6/26: target signature if DPA changes are minor

If anything changes on your side, please flag ahead of the call.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Acceptance_Ownership_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), MSA-DPA-dependency-notes.pdf (pdf)
